state.seed_assertion: Tags that cannot have caused a fault, such as HMI setpoints and recipe numbers, should not be included in a trend because they waste memory and processing without adding diagnostic value.

sentences.1: An equipment maintenance log serves as the institutional memory of a plant, with each entry either adding to the record of what an asset has experienced or creating a gap that will incur costs later.
sentences.2: Paper maintenance logs are vulnerable to loss and cannot provide auditable evidence that they have not been edited after the fact, unlike digital systems.
sentences.3: Begin with the failing connection and time window, then collect targeted traffic if switch and device diagnostics cannot distinguish the cause.
